technical.summary: RTX shows oversold conditions with bullish stochastic cross, but lacks confirmation from moving averages, MACD, and volume; bearish candlestick pattern and weak trend structure limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: RTX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, and earnings arriving in 49 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying by junior members combined with extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of senior conviction and absent news data limit signal strength.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (308), rising dollar, and recession signals create hostile environment for RTX despite 49-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold RSI/Stochastic with bullish cross and extreme fear (VIX 308) create contrarian bounce opportunity near support at 80.26, with 49-day earnings buffer reducing near-term event risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, rising dollar), price below all major moving averages, three black crows pattern, negative volume (CMF/OBV), and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a bear trap setup despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold technicals (RSI 9, Stochastic) with bullish cross present contrarian bounce setup at support; extreme fear (VIX 308) creates asymmetric risk/reward opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro deterioration (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, rising dollar) and complete absence of fundamental/smart money conviction create bear trap risk despite technical oversold conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals and sentiment show contrarian opportunity, but risk and fundamental agents strongly reject entry; debate decisively favors bear case.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 55 positions in Industrials sector (24% of portfolio) creates concentration risk; skip to preserve sector balance and capital for higher-conviction setups.
